tips.text: Throw Boomerang Blade through a minion wave so it also hits the enemy champion. It returns at max range, so you can hit them again on its way back.
Step to a new position before Boomerang Blade returns, so the way back catches enemies who dodged the first pass.
Hold Spell Shield for an enemy stun or root rather than any random ability. It also heals you and gives a burst of speed.
Press Ricochet right after a basic attack to get the most from it. It bounces to nearby enemies, so it's best used on a wave or a grouped fight.
Use Ricochet to clear minion waves fast and push the lane. Then you can recall or roam while the wave hits their turret.
Keep attacking enemy champions in a trade. Each hit gives you a burst of speed from Fleet of Foot, so you can walk away from the fight.
Use On The Hunt to chase or to run away, and to speed up your whole team. Attacking champions with it active shortens your other cooldowns.
Don't spam Boomerang Blade when your mana is low. It costs a lot, so a miss leaves you short for the rest of the lane.

combos.name: Ricochet attack reset
combos.when: Use it in a trade or a fight when you have just landed an auto attack on an enemy.
combos.text: Casting Ricochet right after an auto resets your attack timer. You get the next auto sooner, and it bounces and comes with extra attack speed.

tips.text: Hold Spell Shield for Enchanted Crystal Arrow; blocking it saves you from a long stun and from the damage.
Use Spell Shield on a Volley too. It blocks the whole ability, and you heal and get a burst of speed.
Throw Boomerang Blade through the enemy when minions are not in the way. It deals less damage after hitting minions.
Ashe has few ways to escape, so chase her with On The Hunt once you reach level 6.
Turn on Ricochet when minions and Ashe stand together, so your attacks bounce to hit her too.
Keep Spell Shield ready when Caitlyn is in range; it blocks Piltover Peacemaker, her net and Yordle Snap Trap, and heals you.
Fake an advance, then back off so Caitlyn wastes her Piltover Peacemaker, then step in and trade.
Caitlyn outranges you, so use Boomerang Blade to hit her when she stands behind minions or leans in to last-hit.
Walk around likely trap spots instead of straight lines, since a rooted Sivir is an easy Headshot target.
Push the wave with Ricochet; it bounces across minions and clears waves fast, so you can roam or take tower plates.
Keep Spell Shield ready for Petrifying Gaze when Cassiopeia is close; it blocks the stun and heals you.
Block Noxious Blast with Spell Shield if she aims it at you. She loses her speed boost and her poison.
Fake a step toward Cassiopeia, then back off, so she wastes her spell on the bait.
Walk sideways out of Noxious Blast; it lands after a short delay. Boomerang Blade can punish her when she stands still.
Use Ricochet when minions and Cassiopeia stand together. Its bounces hit her and the minions near her.
Press Spell Shield just as Ezreal is about to fire Mystic Shot or Essence Flux; blocking it heals you and gives you a burst of speed.
Ezreal is fragile, so trade with Boomerang Blade when he steps up to hit a minion, then walk into him with your attacks.
Keep minions between you and Ezreal's shots. Mystic Shot stops at the first enemy it hits.
Fake an advance, then back off. Ezreal may waste his skill shots, or you can bait his Arcane Shift and punish him afterward.
Turn on Ricochet when you trade next to a minion wave. The bounces hit the enemy as well as the minions around him.
Keep Spell Shield ready for Hwei's Torment spells; it blocks Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss or Crushing Maw and heals you.
Hwei needs time to paint his spells, so fake an advance and back off. He wastes a spell and you can trade back.
Stay out of a line with Hwei's minions when he enters his Torment mood. Rush him once his spell is gone and he is exposed.
Throw Boomerang Blade at Hwei when he walks up to cast, and step so it returns through him.
Sidestep Severing Bolt because it is slow; it hurts more if you are alone or rooted.
Use Ricochet to push the wave fast, then trade while Hwei has to answer it.
Hold Spell Shield for Deadly Flourish. Blocking it stops the root and heals you.
Jhin's Captive Audience trap is also blocked by Spell Shield. Use it when you must walk over a place where a trap may be.
Aim Boomerang Blade so it hits Jhin both going out and coming back. Trade when he is reloading.
Fake a step toward Jhin and back off so he wastes Deadly Flourish, then push the wave with Ricochet.
Hold Spell Shield for Zap!, which keeps your movement and heals you.
Don't count on Spell Shield to stop the Flame Chompers! explosion if they are already placed; the wiki says the explosion still happens.
Spell Shield can't stop Jinx's Super Mega Death Rocket! explosion; stay out of her long lines when it is ready.
Throw Boomerang Blade through minions to hit Jinx, and aim to catch her on the way back too.
Fake an advance, then back off so Jinx wastes her Flame Chompers! or Zap!.
Push the wave with Ricochet; it bounces between minions and hits Jinx if she stands near them.
Keep Spell Shield ready for Void Seeker; blocking it also stops the Plasma it would apply, and you heal and get a burst of speed.
Aim Boomerang Blade down the lane to hit Kai'Sa on both passes; you outrange her basic attacks and she has to walk up to you.
Fake an advance, then back off so Kai'Sa wastes Void Seeker or tries to engage into your Spell Shield.
Hit minions and Kai'Sa together with Ricochet so the bounces add damage when she stands near her wave.
Stay near your support. Kai'Sa wants Plasma from your ally's immobilizing effects too, so don't let her catch you alone.
Hold Spell Shield for Kalista's Pierce when she lines up a poke; blocking it heals you and gives you a burst of speed.
Fake an advance, then back off so Kalista wastes her ability on a Spell Shield that is already running out.
Throw Boomerang Blade when Kalista steps up to hit a minion; the blade also hits her on the way back.
Use Ricochet to push the wave quickly, since it bounces between minions, then trade when Kalista is out of position.
Dodge sideways while Kalista winds up an attack; she cannot cancel the wind-up, so she can't dodge your Boomerang Blade at that moment.
Keep Spell Shield ready for Wall of Pain or Requiem. Time it when Karthus is about to cast, and fake an advance first to throw off his timing.
Do not stand next to your minions when Karthus casts Lay Waste; it hurts a lot more when it hits only one target. Stay out of line with where he is aiming.
Use Boomerang Blade to push the wave and hit Karthus on the way out and back. He has to stay in range of it to farm.
Use Ricochet when Karthus is close to his minions, so the bounces hit him and the wave together.
Walk out of the Wall of Pain if you can; touching it leaves you slowed and easier to hit.
Kill Karthus, then move away from his corpse, because he can keep casting after he dies.
Save Spell Shield for Light Binding; blocking it keeps you from being rooted and heals you.
Lux can fake a Light Binding to bait your Spell Shield. Wait for the ability to actually come at you before you use it.
Spell Shield also blocks Lucent Singularity when it goes off, so you can use it against that too.
Do not rely on Spell Shield against Final Spark when she has Illumination on you. Step out of the beam instead, since the red warning shows where it goes.
Throw Boomerang Blade through the minion wave into Lux. It goes through units, and its return trip hits her again.
Turn on Ricochet when you trade near the wave. Its bounces hit Lux and the minions around her.
Push the wave fast with Ricochet so Lux has to answer it. She is easy to catch out of position once she walks up to poke.
Hold Spell Shield for Make It Rain; blocking it heals you and keeps you from being slowed in the zone. Miss Fortune's Bullet Time is not blocked by it.
Fire Boomerang Blade through the minions at Miss Fortune; it keeps going after each hit and hits her again on the way back if she stays.
Trade by pressing Ricochet right after an auto attack; the bounces hit Miss Fortune and her minions together.
Fake a step forward and back to bait Double Up or Make It Rain, then use Spell Shield timing to punish her.
Push the wave with Ricochet and clear it fast, then punish her when she has to stand in range to last-hit.
Hold Spell Shield for Nilah's Slipstream; it is blocked, so she wastes her dash and you heal and speed up.
Do not rely on Spell Shield against her Formless Blade empowered attacks; those are not blocked.
Throw Boomerang Blade at her when she steps up to last-hit, then use Fleet of Foot to walk back out of her reach.
Do not use Ricochet attacks on Nilah while Jubilant Veil is up; she dodges basic attacks.
Stay away when she has Apotheosis; it pulls you in and heals her. Hold Spell Shield for its burst.
Keep Spell Shield up for Achooo! when Smolder lines it up; blocking it saves you the slow and the explosion, and heals you.
Push and trade early while Smolder is weak; he has few Dragon Practice stacks and little damage in the first levels.
Throw Boomerang Blade through Smolder and the minions in front of him, then step so it hits him again on the way back.
Turn on Ricochet when you and Smolder stand near minions; the bounces hit him and the minions around him.
Fake a step in before Smolder uses a spell, then back off, so he wastes Achooo! and you can punish the cooldown.
Hold Spell Shield for Event Horizon or Primordial Burst; blocking it saves you from a stun or a big hit and heals you.
Spell Shield also blocks Dark Matter, so turn it on when you see the landing circle appear on you and you cannot step out.
Walk out of the Dark Matter circle instead of using a spell; it lands after a delay, so keep moving while you hit minions.
Stay inside Event Horizon's ring or well away from it. Only enemies who touch the edge are stunned.
Fake an advance, then back off to make Veigar waste Event Horizon or Baleful Strike before you step in to trade.
Stand away from minions when Veigar aims Baleful Strike; it hits only the first two enemies, so keep the line clear of your minions.
Use Boomerang Blade and Ricochet to push the wave and trade with him. Veigar is fragile and cannot take much damage.
Hold Spell Shield for Yasuo's Steel Tempest whirlwind or his Sweeping Blade dash. Blocking one heals you and gives you a burst of speed.
Yasuo's Last Breath still goes off through Spell Shield, so do not rely on it to stop his ultimate. Stay away from any ally who is knocked up.
Fake an advance, then back off. Yasuo will often waste his Sweeping Blade or Steel Tempest into your shield.
Throw Boomerang Blade on its way out and again as it returns. Yasuo has to dodge it twice, and it is a long-range poke.
Yasuo's Wind Wall destroys your Boomerang Blade. Wait until it is gone before you throw it.
Use Ricochet on the wave to push hard, then trade with Yasuo while he cannot reach you without minions. Pushing leaves him fewer minions to dash through.
Keep Spell Shield ready for Yunara's prayer bead throw; blocking it heals you and gives you a burst of speed.
Fake an advance, then back off, so Yunara wastes her ability before you raise Spell Shield.
Throw Boomerang Blade down the lane when Yunara steps up to last-hit. It hits her on the way out and again on the way back.
Be careful when Yunara powers up with Transcend One's Self. Her beam is long range and leaves you slowed, so stay out of its line.
Use Ricochet when the enemy is near minions, so your attacks bounce between them and the enemy.
Push the wave with Ricochet and Boomerang Blade, then use the free time to roam or take objectives.
Keep Spell Shield ready for Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb or Satchel Charge; blocking one heals you and gives a burst of speed.
Fake an advance, then back off so Ziggs wastes his ability into your Spell Shield.
Walk around the mines from Hexplosive Minefield instead of through them; being slowed makes his other spells easier to land.
Push the wave with Ricochet and Boomerang Blade so Ziggs must answer the wave instead of poking you.
Trade when Ziggs has just used his abilities; many have long cooldowns, so he is weak then.
Throw Boomerang Blade at Ziggs when he stands behind minions; it passes through units and hits him on the way out and back.
